prompt: Who was the head coach of the team that won the Superbowl the year that the show Law & Order: SVU was released?
answer: *Law & Order: SVU* premiered in 1999. The Super Bowl played that year was **Super Bowl XXXIII**, won by the **Denver Broncos**, whose head coach was **Mike Shanahan**.
